strings.en: Pause Omi Instead?
strings.description: Interstitial offered when the delete reason is taking a break or technical issues

strings.en: Stop recording and keep everything. Come back anytime.
strings.description: Subtitle of the pause-instead interstitial

strings.en: Recording stops. Nothing new is captured while you are away.
strings.description: First line of the pause-instead card

strings.en: Your memories, conversations and apps are kept exactly as they are.
strings.description: Second line of the pause-instead card

strings.en: You stay signed in. Resume recording anytime. Your subscription continues unchanged.
strings.description: Pause v1 keeps the session and does not change billing

strings.en: Pause Omi
strings.description: Primary action of the pause-instead interstitial

strings.en: Continue Deleting
strings.description: Secondary action of the pause-instead interstitial; continues the delete flow

strings.en: {count, plural, =1{You have 1 recording still processing. Deleting now loses it.} other{You have {count} recordings still processing. Deleting now loses them.}}
strings.description: Delete confirmation warning when recordings are still processing or not yet uploaded; deleting loses them

strings.en: {days, plural, =1{Sign in again within 1 day to restore your account.} other{Sign in again within {days} days to restore your account.}}
strings.description: Backend-reported grace window; never infer a duration

strings.en: {count, plural, =1{1 recording hasn't uploaded yet. Deleting now loses it — keep the app open to finish uploading.} other{{count} recordings haven't uploaded yet. Deleting now loses them — keep the app open to finish uploading.}}
strings.description: Loss warning only for recordings stored on this phone and not uploaded

strings.en: Review what happens to your data before you leave.
strings.description: Confirmation subtitle when a backend restore window is available

strings.en: Omi is paused. Resume recording anytime.
strings.description: Brief confirmation after capture pause succeeds

strings.en: {count, plural, =1{1 recording is still processing. It is kept with your account for {days} days.} other{{count} recordings are still processing. They’re kept with your account for {days} days.}}
strings.description: Server-held recordings are retained during the backend-reported grace period

strings.en: {days, plural, =1{Your memories and conversations will be erased after 1 day.} other{Your memories and conversations will be erased after {days} days.}}
strings.description: Consequence row; days comes from backend

strings.en: Your apps and integrations disconnect immediately.
strings.description: Immediate effect even during grace

strings.en: Your subscription is cancelled immediately.
strings.description: Immediate cancellation when account deletion is requested

strings.en: Your account is pending deletion
strings.description: Title on sign-in into a pending-deletion account

strings.en: Changed your mind? Restore your account before it is erased.
strings.description: Restore decision description

strings.en: Restore your memories and conversations.
strings.description: Restoration benefit row

strings.en: Your subscription stays cancelled. Reconnect apps and integrations after restoring.
strings.description: Restoring does not restart billing or reconnect revoked integrations

strings.en: {days, plural, =1{You have at least 1 day left to restore your account.} other{You have at least {days} days left to restore your account.}}
strings.description: Whole days rounded down from server wipe_at

strings.en: Restore my account
strings.description: Primary action on pending deletion sign-in

strings.en: Finish deleting
strings.description: Secondary action reveals final erase-now confirmation

strings.en: Erase my account now
strings.description: Destructive confirmation; sends erase_now true

strings.en: This ends the restore window. Your account and its recordings will be permanently erased.
strings.description: Final warning before erase_now
